_meta.index: Book Access Context Index (BACI). Higher = more need.

ingredients.noHS: % adults 25+ without HS diploma (B15002_calc_numLTHSE / B15002_001E), tract
ingredients.LEA: % adults 18+ speaking English less than 'very well' (B16004_calc_numGE18LEAE / B16004_calc_numGE18E), tract
ingredients.ELA: Grade 3 ELA Performance Index, district. Flipped: high PI = low need. EdSight 0 treated as missing.

field_guide.ELA_PI: raw Performance Index (higher = better). Tract and benchmark values are child-weighted means of district PIs
field_guide.p_*: variant A component, 0-100, higher = more need (p_ELA already flipped)
field_guide.z_*: variant B component, z-score, higher = more need (z_ELA already flipped)
field_guide.cls_a / cls_b: 1-5 need class on the shared breaks; 0 = not scored
field_guide.rank_a / rank_b: 1 = highest need among unflagged units of that tier; null if flagged

_meta.variant_A: child-weighted midpoint percentile per ingredient (ELA = 100 - P), averaged
_meta.variant_B: child-weighted z of ln(1+%) per ACS ingredient, -z(PI) for ELA, averaged
_meta.class_def: child-weighted quintiles of populated-hex BACI; every tier is classed with the same breaks
_meta.populated_def: car_bin >= 1 and all three ACS ingredients present

flags.partial_ela: no Grade 3 ELA PI; BACI is the mean of 3 ingredients
